name: IHRISBenefitRecurrence
title: iHRIS Benefit Recurrence
description: The `benefit_recurrence` list as shipped by default in iHRIS 4.3.3 (modules: ihris-manage/module/ihris-manage-Benefit). Codes are the iHRIS record ids. Deployments add their own records, so this is the shipped baseline, not a closed international code set.
